name: Zai Nide Shengyin Li
source:
Yunsheng Ye, a freshman, met Huamo Xue, the head of the Student Union's Event Planning Department, outside his rented apartment. Coincidentally, his apartment was next to hers. Through a series of opportunities, he joined the department and became her trusted assistant.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3589980/_/]Steam[/url]]
